checks.detail: Read-only request completed from the connected Codex plugin.

checks.name: Fresh authenticated market lookup
checks.detail: Fresh read-only request completed through the connected Tidelight Research Codex tool.

checks.name: Company research tools in connected Codex registry
checks.detail: The protected-resource metadata advertises research:run, and the MCP server source implements the company research job tools. The connected Codex tool registry exposes only market search and instrument lookup, so a company research job could not be invoked from this session.

evidence_boundary: This records one earlier authenticated market:read call (100 instruments), one fresh authenticated NVDA market lookup, and the connected tool-registry boundary. It does not claim a Codex MCP research:run invocation, order execution, or completeness and quality of the full instrument universe.
